claim_id.description: Evidence-record identifier; quotation text is not included in this package.

document_id.description: Document identifier used to join provenance.

object_entity_id.description: Resolved claim object entity ID, before inverse/symmetric fusion orientation.

prompt_version.description: Recorded prompt label or not_applicable for recovery.

publication_date.description: Source observation date as recorded; empty string means unknown, not current validity.

relation.description: Predicate; direction is described in the relation table.

resolution_score.description: Resolver heuristic; not validated correctness probability.

source.description: Claims use uppercase SEC/WIKIPEDIA; documents retain lowercase sec/wikipedia.

subject_entity_id.description: Resolved claim subject entity ID, before inverse/symmetric fusion orientation.
